purpose: Descriptive data-feasibility pilot for UK all-weather performance research.
data_status: Manually transcribed from public Racing TV result pages, then arithmetic-checked. These are post-race observations, not pre-race predictions.
selection: Convenience sample: both Class 4 six-furlong handicap divisions at Kempton on 5 October 2026. Division 2 was inspected first; Division 1 was added to include both divisions. This is not an independently selected test set.

definitions.finish_position: Official placing from the result table; do not infer dead heats from rounded elapsed times.
definitions.sp_fractional: Reported industry Starting Price, with favourite suffix removed. Not BSP or a recorded earlier executable quote.
definitions.total_time_s: Reported elapsed time, preserved independently of rounded furlong splits.
definitions.f1_s_to_f6_s: Displayed first-to-sixth furlong times in seconds, each rounded to 0.01 seconds.
definitions.fsp_pct: Reported finishing speed percentage: closing speed relative to the runner's whole-race average. For these six-furlong races the closing segment is two furlongs. This is not a win probability or a comparison with course par.
definitions.time_index: Provider's contextual race time score out of 10, not a probability.

methodology_sources.supports: Free public metrics and historical coverage description; FSP definitions.
Course-specific par context and relationship between pace and finishing speed.
Rating at the time of a race differs from current rating and post-race performance figure.
Past performance figures can be revised using subsequent evidence.
Official current ratings and public exports; no historical-as-of completeness established.

not_acquired: BHA rating-at-race rows or historical as-of rating snapshots
RaceiQ Par FSP values and historical model versions
Earlier timestamped executable prices and market liquidity
bha_access_check: The official ratings page and export link were identified. Web export fetch returned HTTP 418; an ordinary direct request to the ratings page returned HTTP 403. No export file was acquired, and no access restriction was bypassed.
known_caveats: Both 18:45 leading runners display 72.63 seconds, but Mesaafi won by a nose.
Displayed split sums can differ from reported elapsed time by a few hundredths of a second.
Only coverage within these two races was checked; site-wide completeness and bulk access are unverified.
BHA was used for methodology; no BHA runner-level data has been joined to this sample.
